name: smwgraphics-para-enemies
title: Para-Enemies
description:
If using the Para-bomb, use Tweaker to change Parabomb's palette to palette B.
Works with Dakress's Goomba graphics, partially based on it.
A "modernized" Bob-omb with orange legs and a key, a Para-Bomb in the same style, and a Para-Goomba that looks like Dakress's goomba graphics.
Also includes a custom crab and crab egg that works with the original sprite and palette.
